---
title: Interactive
---

```{avenger-sql}
#| label: fig-cars
#| fig-cap: Cars by origin
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT('Europe' AS origin, 3 AS cars), STRUCT('USA', 8)])
|> AGGREGATE mark_bar(x => origin, y => cars, tools => [tooltip()]) AS chart
```

The cars by origin are in @fig-cars.

```{avenger-sql}
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS x, 2 AS y), STRUCT(2, 3), STRUCT(3, 1)])
|> AGGREGATE mark_symbol(x => x, y => y, tools => [navigate()]) AS chart
```
